en: • The 3005 + 3006 formation is wrapped with Alpico Kotsu's image character "Nagisa Fuchihigashi" and the scenery of Kamikochi and Mt. Norikura.
• A set of one Nagisa TRAIN wrapping car and one regular car without wrapping.
• It is possible to assemble one of the cars with panties and the other without panties.
・Compatible with power unit 3 ・Compatible with running trolley T ・Contains 2 cars
